what: Chief religious orders are the Gosains and Bhojkis; Gosains were an important trading community, now much deteriorated by internal dissensions; wholesale trade only, never retail; divided into fraternities headed by Mahants; successor to the gaddi nominated by the Mahant from his chelas
quote: The Gosains were at one time an important trading community, but are now much deteriornted owing to internal dissensions.

what: Gosains principally around Nadaun and Jawala Mukhi, scattered elsewhere; greatest capitalists and traders in the hills; wholesale only; opium (bought in Kulu), charas, shawl-wool, cloth; dealings as far as Hyderabad in the Deccan
quote: They are the greatest capitalists and traders in the hills, and are an enterprizing and sngacions tribe.

what: Wealthiest capitalists of the district are the Gosains; Khatris dominate petty trade
quote: The wealthiest capitalists of the district are the Gosdins

what: Gosains known by the general name Dasnami or Saniasi, in ten tribes; Giri the prevalent tribe, used as patronymic (Fatah Gir, Bahadar Gir); founder Shankar Acharaj whose ten pupils are the patriarchs of the ten sects
quote: The Goséins are distinguished by the general name of Dasnami or Saniasi, and are divided, as the former name implies, into ten tribes.

what: Celibacy prescribed, recruiting by adopting chelas from pure tribes, but in the hills the rule is seldom observed and Gosains marry; sons do not inherit, the adopted disciples do
quote: Bunt in these hills this prohibition is seldom observed, and all the Gosains yield to the temptations of marriage

what: Gosains subdivided into small colleges (akhara) each with a recognised mahant controlling all property, personal and real; mahant elects a successor by word of mouth or the fraternity elects; bhandara distribution of effects
quote: The Gosdins are sub-divided among themselves into small colleges (akhdra), each with a recognised head or mahant.

what: Burial not cremation; cenotaph to Mahadeo called a math; each Gosain at death incorporated with Mahadeo; initiation: tuft severed by the guru, head shaved, guru-mantra
quote: A Gosdin’s body is not burned but buried ; and over his remains a cenotaph is raised, dedicuted to Muhadeo, nnd called a Afath.

what: Principal inhabitants of Jawala Mukhi (pop. 2,424 in 1881) are Gosains; town once larger; shrine of great reputation
quote: The - principal inhnbitants of the town are Gosdins.

what: Bhojkis, Gusains and Jogis have or had some priestly avocations (listed in a tribal/occupational grade)
quote: The Bhojkis, Gusdins, and Jogis, have’ or had some priestly avocations.

what: Jogis of the hills are jogis only in name; live by begging and agriculture, no distinguishing tenets; a separate endogamous race; large numbers of jogis and sannyasis pass through the district
quote: The jogis of the hills are jogis only in name, They live by begging and also engage in agriculture.

what: Temple Pujaris (Bhojkis) said to be originally a mixed collection of Nais, Brahmans, Rajputs and Jogis; Bhojkis perhaps mere jogis with reflected sanctity, intermarrying with Bodha Pandits (a class of jogis)
quote: composed originally, it is said, of a mixed collection of Nais, Brahmans, Réjpits, and Jogis, who all intermarried.

what: Deota "Dandi Chairon" fond of sticks: the name Dandi here is a folk deity, not Dandi sannyasis
quote: The Dandi Chairon, or Dandion-kd-deota, is supposed to be particularly fond of sticks.
